newsitem.title: USA: Calif. governor eyes income tax breaks - report.
newsitem.headline: Calif. governor eyes income tax breaks - report.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson has signalled he may seek a cut in personal income taxes as part of state budget talks, according to a published report on Thursday.
The reduction in revenues could cost the state treasury hundreds of millions of dollars, Capitol sources told the San Francisco Chronicle newspaper.

The Republican governor's Department of Finance has prepared several options, one of which includes widening tax brackets so taxpayers are not pushed to higher rates as quickly, the Chronicle reported.
Wilson in January proposed a 10 percent cut in business taxes. The plan, however, failed to advance in the state legislature.
